# Apt Controls

> Apt Controls is an independent, family-owned distributor of industrial
> process control instruments, electrical, electronics and automation
> products, established in 1993 in Dewas (near Indore), Madhya Pradesh,
> India. It supplies genuine products from 24+ world-leading brands and
> provides calibration and maintenance services.

Key facts:
- Established: 1993 (partnership firm)
- Address: 113, Ram Nagar Extension, A.B. Road, Dewas — 455001 (M.P.), India
- Phone: +91 88781 14492, +91 89894 78358, 07272-253198
- Email: enquiry@aptcontrols.net
- Service area: Dewas–Indore industrial belt, Madhya Pradesh and all India
- Product categories (12+): temperature, pressure, flow, level, analytical
  instruments, indicators & meters, primary sensors, RTD & thermocouple,
  safety instruments, industrial heaters, power solutions, automation & control
- Brands dealt in: WIKA, Autonics, Pepperl+Fuchs, SICK, Telemecanique,
  Omron, ifm electronic, Banner Engineering, Balluff, Baumer, Turck, Pilz,
  Panasonic Industry, Leuze, Schmersal, Euchner, Delta, ebm-papst, Azbil,
  Datalogic, Contrinex, Module, Osna, iTEC
- Services: supply & distribution, instrument calibration, maintenance &
  breakdown support, application guidance and model selection
- Clients include: Cipla, Lupin, Sun Pharma, Mankind Pharma, Glenmark, IPCA,
  Macleods, Piramal, Dabur, Patanjali, Adani, Aditya Birla Group, JSW,
  John Deere, Force Motors, MAHLE, Motherson Sumi, Kirloskar, SRF
